ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA Open-ended Question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: The Tarim River flows along the northern edge of the Taklamakan Desert. Historically, nine major water systems once flowed into the mainstream of the Tarim River. At present, only the three source streams of the Aksu River, Yarkand River, and Hotan River have surface water relations with the mainstream of the Tarim River. Read the “schematic map of the Tarim River Basin” <image1>, fill in the blank: Among the statements about the regional characteristics shown in the figure, the statement that does not conform to reality is “the ____ of the Tarim River has the largest water volume.”

claims.canonical_value: The lower reaches of the Tarim River have the largest water volume

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic map of the Tarim River Basin, marked with a graticule, basin boundary, and rivers. The Tarim River is located within the Tarim Basin and extends along the northern edge of the Taklamakan Desert; source streams such as the Aksu River, Yarkand River, and Hotan River flow into the mainstream from the west and south, and the lower reaches continue to extend eastward. Taitema Lake is also marked in the eastern part of the figure. Then reason: The question asks to find the statement that “does not conform to reality.” The Tarim River is an inland river in an arid area. As river water flows downstream, it continuously decreases due to strong evaporation, infiltration, and irrigation water use along the way. Therefore, the water volume in the lower reaches will not be the largest. On the contrary, saying “the lower reaches of the Tarim River have the largest water volume” does not conform to reality, so the blank should be filled with “lower reaches.”
